shared/build/module-public.mjs

Multi-source public-asset merge for the modular workspace.
Sourcesrc/shared/build/module-public.mjs
UX surfaceVite machinery every module build consumes — never shipped to a browser.

Members

REPO

Repo root — this file sits at shared/build/.

MODULE_PUBLIC_MOUNTS

Module public mounts: { dir } (repo-relative source) → { at } (URL prefix it answers under). Order is irrelevant — the longest prefixes are just connect routes; '/' mounts fall through to next() on misses.

firebaseRewrites

firebase.json hosting rewrites — /robots.txt → /meta/robots.txt and friends. Firebase evaluates these at hosting level, so plain vite dev/vite preview never saw them (Lighthouse fetched the SPA index.html as robots.txt). Reading the config keeps the rewrite table single-sourced; glob sources (/** SPA catch-alls) are excluded — the SPA fallback already owns those.

  • @returns {{ source: string, destination: string }[]} Plain path rewrites.

rewriteMount

Connect middleware applying the firebase rewrites — rewrites req.url to the destination so a later serveMount answers the mapped file. Registered before the mounts.

  • @returns {import('connect').NextHandleFunction} Rewrite handler.

MIME

Minimal content-type table for the dev middleware (build copies need none).

serveMount

Connect middleware serving one module public/ dir at a mount prefix. Misses and path-traversal attempts fall through to next(). Implements single-range byte serving (Accept-Ranges + 206) — media elements probe ranges to discover stream duration and to seek; without them Chrome shows only the buffered seconds and never seeks.

  • @param {string} dirAbs Absolute source directory.
  • @returns {import('connect').NextHandleFunction} Static-file handler.

copyMount

Recursively copies one mount tree into outDir. .json payloads are re-serialized without whitespace on the way out — sources stay human-readable for review while dist ships the minified form the dossier/i18n fetches actually download. Anything unparseable is copied verbatim so a hand-tuned fixture can never break the build. Binary and text assets pass through untouched.

  • @param {string} src Absolute source directory.
  • @param {string} dest Absolute destination directory.

modulePublicPlugin

Vite plugin merging every module public/ into the served/built site.

  • @param {object} [opts] Options.
  • @param {boolean} [opts.copy] Force-copy into outDir on build (default: only
  • @returns {import('vite').Plugin} The plugin instance.
